value.title: Requirement 1: 18 CP
value.description: 24 credit points from the official 2026 specialisation table.

rawData.name: Requirement 1: 18 CP
rawData.rawText: Students complete 18 credit points from the following:

units.name: Data Science, Big Data and Data Variety
units.prerequisite: DATA1002 or DATA1902 or INFO1110 or INFO1910 or INFO1903 or INFO1103 or ENGG1810

units.name: Big Data and Data Diversity (Advanced)
units.prerequisite: 75% or above from (DATA1002 or DATA1902 or INFO1110 or INFO1910 or INFO1903 or INFO1103 or ENGG1810)

units.name: Data Analytics: Learning from Data
units.assumedKnowledge: Successful completion of a first-year or second-year unit in statistics or data science including a substantial coding component. The content from STAT2X11 will help but is not considered essential. Students who are not comfortable using the R software for statistical analysis should familiarise themselves before attempting the unit, e.g. taking OLET1632: Shark Bites and Other Data Stories
units.prerequisite: DATA1X01 or ENVX1002 or BUSS1020 or ECMT1010 or MATH1062 or MATH1962 or MATH1972 or [MATH1X05 and (MATH1001 or MATH1002 or MATH1003 or MATH1004 or MATH1021 or MATH1023 or MATH1115 or MATH19XX)]

units.name: Data Analytics: Learning from Data (Adv)
units.assumedKnowledge: Successful completion of a first-year or second-year unit in statistics or data science including a substantial coding component. The content from STAT2X11 will help but is not considered essential. Students who are not comfortable using the R software for statistical analysis should familiarise themselves before attempting the unit, e.g. taking OLET1632: Shark Bites and Other Data Stories
units.prerequisite: A mark of 65 or greater in (DATA1X01 or ENVX1002 or BUSS1020 or ECMT1010 or MATH1062 or MATH1962 or MATH1972 or [MATH1X05 and (MATH1001 or MATH1002 or MATH1003 or MATH1004 or MATH1021 or MATH1023 or MATH1115 or MATH19XX)])

units.name: Probability and Estimation Theory
units.prerequisite: (MATH1X61 or MATH1971 or MATH1X21 or MATH1931 or MATH1X01 or MATH1906 or MATH1011) and (DATA1X01 or MATH1X62 or MATH1972 or MATH10X5 or MATH1905 or STAT1021 or ECMT1010 or BUSS1020)

units.name: Probability and Statistical Models (Adv)
units.prerequisite: (MATH1X61 or MATH1971 or MATH1X21 or MATH1931 or MATH1X01 or MATH1906 or MATH1011) and a mark of 65 or greater in (DATA1X01 or MATH10X5 or MATH1905 or STAT1021 or ECMT1010 or BUSS1020 or MATH1X62 or MATH1972)

value.title: Requirement 2: 6 CP
value.description: 24 credit points from the official 2026 specialisation table.

rawData.name: Requirement 2: 6 CP
rawData.rawText: Students complete 6 credit points from the following:

units.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
units.assumedKnowledge: Data structures and algorithms as covered in COMP2123 or COMP2823.
units.prerequisite: INFO1110 or INFO1910 or ENGG1801 or ENGG1810 or DATA1002 or DATA1902

units.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (Adv)
units.assumedKnowledge: Data structures and algorithms as covered in COMP2123 or COMP2823.
units.prerequisite: (INFO1110 or INFO1910 or ENGG1810 or DATA1002 or DATA1902) and distinction-level results in at least one 2000-level COMP or MATH or SOFT unit

units.name: Scalable Data Management
units.assumedKnowledge: This unit of study assumes that students have previous knowledge of database structures and of SQL. The prerequisite material is covered in DATA2001 or ISYS2120. Familiarity with a programming language (e.g. Java or C) is also expected
units.prerequisite: DATA2001 or DATA2901 or ISYS2120 or INFO2120 or INFO2820

units.name: Human-in-the-Loop Data Analytics
units.assumedKnowledge: Basic statistics, database management, and programming
units.prerequisite: (DATA2001 or DATA2901) and (DATA2002 or DATA2902)

value.title: Requirement 1: 18 CP
value.description: 24 credit points from the official 2026 specialisation table.

rawData.name: Requirement 1: 18 CP
rawData.rawText: Students complete 18 credit points from the following:

units.name: Digital Logic
units.assumedKnowledge: ELEC1601. This unit of study assumes some knowledge of digital data representation and basic computer organisation

units.name: Embedded Systems
units.assumedKnowledge: ELEC1601 and ELEC2602. Logic operations, theorems and Boolean algebra, data representation, number operations (binary, hex, integers and floating point), combinational logic analysis and synthesis, sequential logic, registers, counters, bus systems, state machines, simple CAD tools for logic design, basic computer organisation, the CPU, peripheral devices, software organisation, machine language, assembly language, operating systems, data communications and computer networks
units.prerequisite: ELEC1601 and ELEC2602

value.title: Requirement 2: 6 CP
value.description: 24 credit points from the official 2026 specialisation table.

rawData.name: Requirement 2: 6 CP
rawData.rawText: Students complete 6 credit points from the following:

units.name: Computer Architecture
units.assumedKnowledge: ELEC3607. Knowledge of microprocessor systems (embedded systems architecture, design methodology, interfacing and programming) is required
units.prerequisite: ELEC2602

units.name: Digital Signal Processing
units.assumedKnowledge: Familiarity with basic Algebra, Differential and Integral Calculus, continuous linear time-invariant systems and their time and frequency domain representations, Fourier transform, sampling of continuous time signals
